## Findings considered and refused

1. Unit 0 · ኀበ 'where' kept as the literal gloss in the note: not removed, because 'where' is what the form means; the house reading is now the rendering (change #4).
2. Unit 3 · ሊቃናተ እስራኤል with the accusative -ተ and the doubt whether '70' numbers the chiefs: the note already lays out both readings with (?); no better reading from the grammar, left.
3. Unit 4 · ተመስዉ 'melted' and ውዝዋዜ 'swinging': both hedged (?) in the note, and 'melted' suits ሠምዕ 'wax'; left. 'put the incense in' (ወደዩ ዕጣነ): the 'in' is idiomatic English for the phrase; left.
4. Unit 5 · the end of God's speech at ተቀደሰ በሞተ ዚአሆሙ and the allegory outside the quotation marks: the note says so; reading kept. ዘበ መዐዛሁ 'in whose fragrance' is hedged (?); left.
5. Unit 6 · 'go up to the throne' for ዲበ 'upon' in i: sense not harmed (l has 'upon'); left. ይወርዲ with -ዲ already hedged.
6. Unit 8 · ከመ ፀርቀ ትክቶ: obscure; the note says CRUX and (?) and i has (?). 'In the measure of his vexation' is a guess, but I have no better rendering from the grammar (ፀርቀ is not found in anything I may use); left, honestly marked. አስቆረራ from ቆረረ likewise hedged.
7. Unit 17 · ቅስት 'bow' against ቅሥት 'scourge': both readings are in the note with (?); left. 'believe' for the perfect አምኑ in i: a generic present; l has the perfect; left.
8. Unit 18 · the whole clause is obscure and every doubtful word already carries (?); the draft is honest; I changed only what is demonstrably wrong (#6). Quote placement of 'I' (God) outside the quotation marks is explained in the note; left.

Checked and found sound: Numbers 16:1 (Reubenites), 16:17-18, 16:30-33, 16:35, 16:37-38, 16:41, 16:46-49, 17:1-3, 17:10 (all stated accurately, each marked 'compare'/'allusion', the Kebra Nagast variations named); Genesis 28:12 and Psalm 141:2, Revelation 8:3-4; Numbers 12:3 (meekness of Moses); Exodus 32:13. Verb-form labels in the other notes (ወሰሚዖ gerund, ግበሩኬ 2mp imperative, የዐጥኑ jussive, ውዕዩ, ወደዩ, ተቀደሰ tä-stem, አውዐዮሙ causative, ተኀትመት, ፈትሐት, ወውኅጠቶሙ, ወበከዩ, ወአስተስረዩ, ተዘከር, ንግሮሙ, ወበሎሙ, ቀድሱ, ወአምጽኡ, ይጽሐፍ, ኢትጽሐፍ, ጸሐፍ, አርአይኩ) match the forms. Names follow house forms (Moses, Aaron, Abraham, Isaac, Mary, Zion, Christ). Holy of Holies, 'kingdom of heaven' consistent with ch96b. A point for the glosser, not changed here: known-forms ዘርኦሙ says 'anticipating ለአበዊነ', but this part has no ለአበዊነ; the entry must not be broadened with that remark, and the sheet for ሰሚዖሙ (converb, -ሙ as subject) and ሐመየ (slander) should be checked against the changes above.
